# Expected values for the split of a road by a flag, captured from the original program in the emulator (ADR 0008).
# Each section is one run of tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py; its command follows the section name, and the lines under it are the
# emulator's output with the label, the clock, the storage item, and the generator words left out. Only passes that changed a
# settler (s<slot>=, 16 bytes), a flag item (f<slot>=, 70 bytes), a building item (b<slot>=, 18 bytes), or a map byte
# (m=x,y:index=old>new, index 0 the flag byte, 3 the object byte, 4 the link) are listed, from 40 passes before the click on.
# In remove: runs the flag table starts with the dummy in slot 0: the castle's flag is slot 1, the flag at 20,6 slot 2, and the
# new flag slot 3 (slot 7 in split-nofree-1000). click=p@x,y is the flag button (0x442244), b@x,y the building placement (0x449a63),
# c@x,y the evaluator's node state and site. In road: runs the castle's flag is slot 0.
# Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
